title: Democrats pick new Senate candidate in Maine in aftermath of Platner debacle
description: Troy Jackson won his party's nomination by commandeering the progressive movement that fueled Graham Platner's rise. He will face off against GOP Sen. Susan Collins in November.

title: Biden ghostwriter tapes to be released
description: Former President Joe Biden is declining to appeal a court ruling that allows the Justice Department to publicize recordings of conversations between him and a writer collaborating on his memoir.

title: Week in Politics: Iran War; Trump attends solemn ritual; nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia
description: The Trump administration is seeking tens of billions of dollars in supplemental appropriations for the Iran War, a war which the president and allies have repeatedly claimed is already won.

title: Democrats in Maine formally nominate Troy Jackson as their new candidate for U.S. Senate
description: Democrats are hoping to move past Graham Platner's scandal-plagued campaign as they look to unseat Susan Collins. In Jackson, they chose a nominee with a similar economic populist message as Platner.

title: 'The show must go on.' Trump makes jabs at rescheduled White House Correspondents' dinner
description: President Trump used his speech to attack his political opponents, members of the media and even members of his own cabinet.

title: To track down government leakers, Trump supports pursuing journalists
description: Hours before addressing the White House press corps, the president endorsed using subpoenas against reporters in national security leak investigations.

title: Trump swings back toward diplomacy in escalating war with Iran
description: After threatening a “massive attack,” the president said his envoys were talking with Tehran but left open the possibility of a sharp military escalation.

title: Michigan’s Whitmer endorses in key Senate race
description: The popular governor lends her weight to centrist Haley Stevens in the race.

title: Democrats approve new primary election calendar, putting South Carolina first
description: Democrats chose South Carolina for the first 2028 presidential primary, then Nevada, prioritizing Black and Latino voters. New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan and Virginia also hold early contests.

title: St. Louis Democratic House primary exposes party rifts over Israel
description: St. Louis Public Radio hosted one of the first media appearances this year between Rep. Wesley Bell and former Congresswoman Cori Bush. The primary race is a rematch of a race Bush lost last year to Bell.

title: Mali’s government does not rule out U.S. military intervention
description: The country’s foreign minister said, however, that anyone wishing to partner with the West African nation “must respect” its sovereignty.

title: Trump's replacement tariffs continue to put pressure on U.S. economy
description: President Trump slapped replacement tariffs on 59 countries and the European Union to replace expiring ones.

title: A defiant Trump imposes replacement tariffs on biggest U.S. trading partners
description: The administration timed a new set of tariffs on all of its largest trading partners to take effect at the same time the old, global tariff ended.

title: Indian activist Wangchuk ends 26-day hunger strike as 'Cockroach' protesters vow to press on
description: Indian activist Sonam Wangchuk ended a 26-day hunger strike on Friday that helped galvanize a youth movement that's become one of India's largest protests in recent years, but demonstrators vowed to continue until the education minister resigns.

title: Justice Dept. drops 'New York Times' subpoenas under pressure from judge
description: The Justice Department is dropping the subpoenas it filed demanding grand jury testimony and phone records from New York Times journalists after sharp questioning Thursday from a federal judge.
